description: Content card with media, information and actions, in different compositions.

howToUse: Use it for items people browse and compare by picture and facts: listings, products, places, courses.
Fill `title`, `media` and a few `facts`; add `badges`, `summary` or `matchScore` when they help decide.
Choose `layout` by place: vertical in grids, horizontal in lists. Put the actions in `actions`.
In new code, import it as ContentCard.
alternatives: A destination with one line of context: NavCard.
Deciding on items one at a time: DecisionDeck.

keyboard.action: Moves through the media controls and the actions of the card.
Shows the previous or next photo, as in MediaGallery.
